Text:
- New Dragonstone High Helm
- Updated Dragonstone High armour textures

- Added a travel safety boost to Canon Children modifiers and to the Fertility & Health boost (if using the game rule)
- Gwayne Hightower (son of Otto) now gets his personal CoA upon birth in the Canon Children system, like other characters

- New Needle sword artefact, created on Arya's birth via Canon Children (later there will be a historical version too)
- Robert I Baratheon and Rhaegar Targaryen now spawn their correct armours when born via Canon Children
- New Canon Children for Tytos Lannister (son of Gerold)
- Kiera of Tyrosh no longer gets the pregnancy negation modifier after Valarr Targaryen's stillborn children, if using the Canon Children system
- Fixed traits for Martyn Lannister when born via Canon Children
- Expanded Canon Children to Ormund Baratheon (son of Lyonel)
- Added new Dragonstone armour (High/Rhllor/Low variants)
- New Dark Sister model (compatible with Legacy of the Dragon, depending on what game rules you have enabled)

- Willas Tyrell (son of Mace) now has falconer trait xp on game start or via the Canon Children system
- New Canon Children for Balon Greyjoy
- Expanded the Tyrell Canon Children to Luthor Tyrell's generation

- Kevan Lannister now betrothed to Dorna Swyft in earlier bookmarks to faciliate having his Canon Children
- Joffrey now becomes Tommen's bully automatically via the Canon Children system, or automatically in later bookmarks
- Jon Flowers now joins his father on Dragonstone on game start (if Stannis Baratheon is landed)

- Renly's Crown will now automatically spawn on the Canon Children (NON-historical) version of Renly if he ever becomes a king
- The Lord Paramount Contract Fix game rule now checks the North, Dragonstone, and Dorne for if they've been given alternate special contracts (i.e., Scutage, Marcher, Palatinate) before assigning their canon ones. Their lore-accurate special contract will now ONLY be applied if the contract was reset to "None", otherwise it keeps whatever the player gave them (e.g., if a player allowed the Lord of the North to call himself King via the Palatinate contract, upon his death his successor will keep that Palatinate contract rather than it reverting to Marcher)
- Changed the Canon Children icon to be the same "i" symbol used for Historical Characters
- Removed the AGOT+ Targaryen Invader game rule due to becoming obsolete with the recent AGOT update
- Added secondary colour to the CoA of House Baratheon of Dragonstone

- New Aemon Targaryen (the Dragonknight) DNA
- Fixed some triggers in the Targaryen invasion game rule: (1) it will now only destroy titles if the holder is AI, and (2) it will only bond with Daenerys' dragons if they are not already bound to another dragon

- Added Randyll Tarly's children to the Canon Children system
- Added Howland Reed's children to the Canon Children system
- Alannys Harlaw (wife of Balon Greyjoy) now gets the Canon Children pregnancy negation modifier on game start if using the associated game rule, despite Balon's children not yet being in the Canon Children system

- Added Rickon Stark (father of Cregan) to the Canon Children system, allowing his children to be born in-game
- Maegelle Targaryen (daughter of Jaehaerys I) now has the Draconic Disinterest character modifier, and also gets it together with Vaegon if born in the Canon Children system (with traits enabled)

- Fixed the Targaryen invasion game rule to properly spawn dragons and add other claimants to the main claimant's court again
- Fixed Saera Targaryen's Canon Children not being born properly
- Fixed Hugh the Hammer's Canon Children not being born properly
- Aegon II's optional cadet branch now has the Dragonriding House modifier

- New dragon looks for Morghul and Shrykos
- Rhaenys Targaryen (daughter of Aemon) now has a base-level amount of Dragon Training xp
- Added pre-set XP levels for the Dragonrider trait
- Fixed dragon colours not being correctly applied due to the genes being renamed
- Added text to the Canon Children modifier for Daenerys Targaryen (daughter of Aegon IV)
- Canon Children born while the mother is travelling are added to her travel entourage
- Expanded the Targareyn Canon Children system to Aerys II's generation, making it now possible to create the entire Targaryen House from Aegon the Conqueror to Young Griff.
- Expanded the Targaryen Canon Children system to Daeron the Drunken's children and Aerion Brightflame's children.

- Expanded the Targaryen Canon Children system down to Aegon V's generation.
- Added custom traits for all the Targaryens newly included in the Canon Children expansion.

- Bastard Canon Children can now properly be born matrilineally
- Expanded the Canon Children system to Kevan Lannister's children
- Daenerys' dragons more consistently spawn at the invader's location when invading Westeros.

- Integrated the Robert's Rebellion-era Daynes into the Canon Children system
- Added new game rule for spawning other Targaryens alongside the main claimant during a Targaryen Invasion (with an optional setting for making them all dragon-riders)
- Characters wearing crowns on death now continue to wear them in their death portrait (right now only works with vanilla AGOT crowns, AGOT+ crowns, and Legacy of the Dragon crowns).
- Jacaerys, Lucerys, and Joffrey Velaryon now properly hatch their canon dragons if using the canon hatching game rule from vanilla AGOT

- Daenerys Targaryen and Viserys Targaryen now have custom perks unlocked if using the Canon Children system or the Alternate Traits/Relationships game rule (including the invader versions of each character)
- Dragons now universally get a saggy neck as they age.
- Robin Arryn no longer has the possibility of being a bastard in the Canon Children system. It now treats him as legitimate and must be born from Jon Arryn.
- Canon Children bastards which get exposed prior to birth once again get the bastard trait properly.

- Added new game rule to give Velaryons their HBO appearances (currently includes Corlys, Laena, and Laenor). Has also been integrated into the Canon Children system depending on if you have the HBO Velaryon game rule enabled or not

- Fixed an issue where Canon Children only became their father's House/culture/faith, regardless of whether their parents are matrilineally married or not (Known loophole: if the father dies BEFORE the wife gets her pregnancy notification event, the pregnancy will default to the father's House as it's not possible to run a check on matrilineal/patrilineal marriages if one of the two spouses are dead, i.e., there is no longer a marriage to check)
- The Targaryen scripted invaders Daenerys/Viserys/Aegon now properly receive their Canon Children modifiers
- The Targaryen scripted invaders Daenerys/Viserys/Aegon now get their canon traits if on a historical game mode (the same traits they'd get with the Alternate Traits/Relationships game rule or Canon Children)
- Fixed issue where the Canon Children version of Laenor Velaryon wasn't given his proper hairstyle, DNA, etc.
- Fixed issue where Viserys would auto-start bond schemes with Meleys

- Renly Baratheon now has a beauty trait if using the alternate traits game rule or Canon Children
- Expanded dragon bonding game rule to more historical characters

- Aegon II Targaryen is now Arbitrary instead of Arrogant under the Canon Children system (or the alternate traits game rule, if enabled) to better represent his personality.
- Added further descriptions to Aegon IV Targaryen and Daeron II Targaryen's Canon Children modifiers to let the players know that their Canon Children will be added at a later time (it's still WIP).

- Maegelle Targaryen will no longer auto-bond with Meleys
- Removed the Dragonriding House modifier from House Tryzaen
- Added new game rule for Canon Children to auto-bond with their canon dragons

- Daemon Targaryen (son of Baelon) starts with the Dreadful perk under the Canon Children system and/or with the alternate traits game rule enabled
- Updated CoAs for dragonseed Houses

- Historical Margaery Tyrell will no longer have the Seductress/Schemer traits
- Daemon Targaryen (son of Baelon) now has different commander traits under the Canon Children system and/or with the alternate traits game rule

- Fixed Jaehaera Targaryen (daughter of Aegon II)'s Canon Children appearance/modifier, which were incorrectly being sourced from Aerea Targaryen (daughter of Aegon)
- Fixed some traits in the Canon Children system
- Changed Laena's death conditions to be by dragonfire after her third birth (if she's a dragonrider and the player has historical mode enabled), rather than simply suicide. KNOWN ISSUE: currently gives Laena the kinslayer trait post-death because she technically "executed" herself. Will look into a solution.

- Dragonkeepers now only wear robes if the Valyrian DNA game rule is enabled (in the future it will be dependant on the Valyrian CLOTHES game rule, once I have actual clothes to add)
- Valyrians born via Canon Children now speak the Common Tongue
- Expanded the Canon Children system to encompass Corlys Velaryon's children and Otto Hightower's children.

- Overhauled the Canon Children system to avoid uncontrollable events like children suddenly becoming sickly and dying, wives dying in childbirth, or the gender variable resetting and getting the wrong gendered child.
- Expanded the Canon Children system to include Cregan Stark's children.
- Added new game rule under the Canon Children system to prevent wives from getting pregnant after having all their Canon Children.
- Tweaked traits for some characters in the Canon Children system if using the relevant game rule.
- Tweaked Aemond Targaryen (son of Viserys I)'s traits if using the relevant game rule or the Canon Children system

- Targaryen crowns are dynamically created for the proper Targaryen ruler under the Canon Children system once they ascend to the Iron Throne. E.g., if you start as Aegon the Conqueror and your playthrough runs until Aegon the Unworthy, when he becomes King his crown artefact will be created for him.
- Added missing Canon Children descriptions for Larys Strong, Alyn Velaryon, and Addam Velaryon.
- Added more Dance of the Dragons-era DNAs

- Expanded the Canon Children system for the Targaryens, adding in all the early Targaryen members from Aegon the Conqueror to Aegon the Unworthy
- Everyone in the Canon Children system now has hidden disease resistance to prevent them catching a random illness and ruining a playthrough by killing a key character you need.
- Added some more Dance of the Dragons-era DNAs
- New Dance of the Dragons-era DNAs
- Changed personality traits of Dance of the Dragons-era characters when using the alternate relations game rule

- Added new Dance of the Dragons-era DNAs
- Expanded the Canon Children system to include new Targaryens
